description: This file provides a standalone Python module for aligning and correcting subtitles without dependencies on web frameworks like FastAPI. It defines a primary interface function 'write_corrected_alignment' that aligns subtitles to a transcript, applies text corrections, and writes an SRT file. It utilizes internal modules for alignment and correction, and includes utilities for formatting and file handling.
